messages.subject: Legend label size
parts:
Hi, 

I tried to increase the size of all the text in a plot using theme(text = element_text(size = rel(5))). All the text within the plot seemed to respond to rel() but legend label text did not behave as I expected. Is that normal?

Best,

Mehmet

messages.author: 936ef8c6d12fc338
messages.subject: Re: Legend label size
parts:
If you want to increase all text size use theme_grey(base_size = new_size)
